subject: Civic Education
lesson: Names the democratic features in a family: Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Competency Level 8.2.1
unique_learning_outcome: Names the democratic features in a family.
Describes the democratic features in a school.
Explains how the democtratic features in a family help its wellbeing.
Explains the importance of working in the school society adapting the democratic values.
Expresses the importance of developing features of a democratic life as a member of a family.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher writes or reads “Names the democratic features in a family” and asks students to name one example they have seen in everyday life. Students share brief responses; the teacher connects their examples to Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Competency Level 8.2.1 and explains how it will help them explore this period's outcome.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Delivers prompts/cue cards; students inspect tasks.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students arrange themselves in assigned group roles, examine the inquiry prompt concerning 'Names the democratic features in a family', and prepare materials for their investigation.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Present findings and review another group's proposal.

summary: Synthesize key student findings from Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Competency Level 8.2.1, emphasizing the core principles of “Names the democratic features in a family” and clarifying any lingering misconceptions.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Use the student's five-minute assignment response to check understanding of “Names the democratic features in a family” and give one concise correction or affirmation.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Each student completes a short exit response explaining one finding about “Names the democratic features in a family” using evidence or an example from Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Competency Level 8.2.1. The teacher reviews responses for an accurate link to the period outcome.
